name: PhishVN QR study
description: Data behind the quishing study of the PhishVN project: how often phishing pages aimed at Vietnam carry a QR code, how OpenCV, PyZbar, WeChatQR and ZXing fail on degraded codes, and whether a small restoration network helps. It holds the decode results of a 792,000-render synthetic sweep (2,000 URLs x 4 error-correction levels x 3 module sizes x 33 variants) for four decoders, the decode results and checkpoints of three restoration networks, and the collection ledgers of the prevalence audit with the author's verdict on every page that carried a code. URLs in the benchmark tables are represented by a 16-hex SHA-1 prefix. The synthetic images are not included; they are generated deterministically from the URL identifiers, the seed and the transformation parameters. The notebook notebooks/qr/qr_walkthrough.ipynb in https://github.com/vuthainguyen1602/phishvn recomputes every number of the paper from these files. See README.md for the file list.
